name: Ten Tips in One Breath
why_it_works: Speed is the hook: ten tips in about twenty seconds feels like a dare to keep up. Viewers rewatch to catch what they missed and save it to read slowly later, both of which feed the algorithm. Density reads as expertise.

hook.pattern: Challenge the viewer to keep up with a rapid list delivered at breakneck pace.
examples: Ten {{topic}} tips in twenty seconds. Keep up.
Pause on whichever one you're breaking.

variables.name: tips_1_to_3
variables.description: Tips 1-3 as short phrases separated by slashes, each starting with a capital letter; 15 words or fewer in total
variables.example: Pat, don't rub / Sunscreen goes last / Two fingers of SPF for your face

variables.name: tips_4_to_6
variables.description: Tips 4-6, same style; 15 words or fewer in total
variables.example: Wash pillowcases weekly / One new product at a time / Patch test first

variables.name: tips_7_to_9
variables.description: Tips 7-9, same style; 15 words or fewer in total
variables.example: Moisturize damp skin / Don't skip your neck / Retinol at night only

variables.name: tip_10
variables.description: The tenth tip, the one that matters most; starts with a capital letter, 6 words or fewer

variables.name: lead_magnet
variables.description: Free full version to send people to; 5 words or fewer

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print for the client's niche, from compliance/packs.json
variables.example: Results vary. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.

visual.prompt: Creator from {{brand}} facing camera mid-inhale, a stopwatch held up beside their face, bright ring light, plain wall, tight vertical 9:16
Flat lay of everyday {{topic}} essentials on a bright surface, organized grid, top-down, even daylight, vertical
Same creator exhaling, relaxed smile, stopwatch lowered, soft light, vertical 9:16

cta: Save this, and get {{lead_magnet}} from the link in bio.

craft.technique: Speed run with a hard brake
craft.notes: Nine tips fly by in kinetic text at a pace slightly too fast to read, then the tenth slows down completely. The tempo change tells the viewer which tip matters most without saying so. Captions carry the speed; voiceover can be sped up 1.2x in the edit.

do_not: Make any single tip need a caveat; if it needs one, cut it
Put the most important tip anywhere but last
Use tiny fonts; the fast section must still be readable on pause
compliance: Skincare: tips are general care, not treatment; no claims to cure acne or other conditions
Financial advisor: tips are general education, not personalized advice; no return or income promises; follow FINRA/SEC advertising rules
Fitness: no guaranteed weight-loss or body-change claims
Fitness and skincare: results vary; tips are general care, with no FDA, disease or treatment claims
